Abstract
Vision-language-action (VLA) models are ex-

than How-level instructions that specify how to

It shows that the gained responsiveness does

How-level instructions. How-level instruction
following thus remains an open challenge.1

7 Conclusion
We find that current VLAs struggle to follow How-
level instructions. Enriched instructions based
on our data hypothesis make actions respond to
them without consistently raising task success. On
SIMPLER-IN, which requires How-level instruc-

ones. We hope that our diagnoses and SIMPLER-

to carry out the task rather than what the task is.
